messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
The Tesla Model S is not officially sold in India yet, so there isn’t an official retail price.  
If you take the U.S. launch price (about **$90 000** for the base variant) and convert it to Indian rupees using the current exchange rate (roughly **₹82 per dollar**), you get:

\[
\$90{,}000 \times 82 \approx ₹7{,}380{,}000 \;(\text{≈ ₹73.8 lakh})
\]

Because India imposes high import duties on electric vehicles (often 30–40 % plus GST), the final landed cost could easily double that figure. A realistic estimate for a fully loaded Model S in India would therefore be in the range of **₹1.2–1.5 crore** (₹12–15 million).

So, while there’s no official price yet, you can expect the Model S to cost roughly **₹1.2–1.5 crore** once it becomes available in India.
